build: 2026-11-17 verified public original X status expansion + district labels + per-leader topic analytics
scope: Curated source-checked research batch; NOT a complete census of reporting or posts
notes: Every item has a source URL and its publisher's publication date; dates are not necessarily event dates.
Counts show only items captured in this research batch, not relative political activity or media attention.
X post permalinks were recovered from publisher embeds. They may require a login or be inaccessible via crawlers; source page corroborates link.
No individually verifiable historic Meta or LinkedIn post URL has been recovered in this batch; public account and issue-search links are discovery only.
When an issue/leader filter returns no records, that means not yet captured, not that no reporting or posts exist.
Allegations, proposed schemes and projected outcomes must not be represented as established wrongdoing or completed results.
Original research batch now augmented with date-checked reporting across all six leaders; some stories about the same event from different publishers are separate source entries.

Additional exact X status permalinks were recovered from HTML embeds on the public publisher pages. Tweet creation dates verified using X snowflake IDs; headlines are sourced from surrounding publisher reports and are not represented as verbatim original post text.
17 November expansion added individually dated publisher links and recovered original X status URLs from publisher embeds. New items have not been included in the earlier 16 November HTTP-link audit.

District links are either editorially tagged to a named location in the report or title/summary text matches; they represent reported geographic mentions, not precise incident coordinates or verified administrative attribution.
Additional 17 November post references are individual X status links corroborated by publisher embed capture, not search result pages or unverified quote transcriptions.

17 November: individually read 171 newly discovered original X status URLs, of which 161 were accessible with matching account and date and 159 had usable body excerpts; 10 unavailable, 2 not readable. Issue coding is provisional keyword-assisted; non-issue ceremonial/general posts are explicitly categorised separately and never forced into the ten-issue hierarchy.
X post text snippets are short headline excerpts only; click original source for context, provenance, and any changed/deleted content.

17 Nov X expansion: individual original X status pages were fetched and their author/date verified; issue/headline is manually researcher-coded. Only policy-related original posts with supported classification were added; generic sports congratulations and unrelated condolences remain in external candidate audit, not falsely counted within ten policy issues.
The X ledger remains a non-exhaustive research sample. Quantities do not measure the complete number of X posts published by any leader.

records.title: Small traders' interests in proposed UPI charges

records.title: BJD rally against mineral taxation changes

records.title: Vijayadashami festival greeting

records.summary: At a Jana Sampark gathering Patnaik alleged deteriorating governance and questioned development claims; his assessment was contested by the government.

records.summary: Addressing party workers, Patnaik claimed price increases and government decisions were affecting farmers, women and students; the claims are attributed.

records.summary: He claimed BCJD won about half of university positions and 60% of college seats while alleging unfair practices; figures and allegations were not independently certified by this report.

records.summary: The LoP sought the CM's intervention regarding Kotia and backed a delegation to collect local concerns amid an Odisha–Andhra administrative dispute.
